# altr_classifier_collection (Data Source)

Data source for retrieving information about a classifier collection, including ALTR-managed collections.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) ALTR Solutions, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
data "altr_classifier_collection" "example" {
  name = "ALTR Managed"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the collection.

### Read-Only

- `classifier_count` (Number) Number of classifiers in the collection.
- `classifier_names` (List of String) Names of the classifiers in the collection.
- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the collection.
